Apple's Glass-Centric iPhone Is Still on Schedule to Mark Device's 20th Anniversary
videos.description: Apple's planned glass-centric iPhone remains on track for 2027, Bloomberg reports, despite a Jefferies analyst saying supply-chain checks suggested the device had been canceled. Bloomberg Intelligence's Anurag Rana explains how new designs could help lift average selling prices for iPhone amid rising memory costs. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." The company expects to launch iPhone Pro models next year that will make use of a new glassy look, with glass used on the front and back of the phones and curving into the sides. Next year is the device's 20th anniversary.

videos.title: Fmr. FDA, CDC Official on Cyclospora, Food Safety Issues
videos.description: Steve Ostroff, Former Acting Commissioner of the FDA and Former Deputy Director of the National Center for Infectious Diseases at the CDC, joined the program to discuss the public awareness timeline of the cyclospora outbreak. The conversation highlighted that while the outbreak became widely known in early to mid-July, there were reports suggesting that government agencies had knowledge of the issue weeks prior to public disclosure. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
